name: cloud-kg-store
description: Cloud KG Store (#1207) - the fleet's knowledge-graph store and browser, three sections on the bottom nav: Cloud (two rows of groups: Application = Binary, Web/Debug, MCP search tools, API Data and API Debug with GET and POST; Repo = Code, CGC, MCP search tools, API Semantic and GraphRAG; every page is backed by the fleet endpoints declared in ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints - c3-infra-api, cloud-me-api, c3-public-api, the two CGC MCP services and embeddings-api - and says plainly when an endpoint is missing or does not answer), Phone (the installed Android apps index through PackageManager: package, version, permissions and components) and Web (News, Media, Shopping, Real Estate, Jobs, Business, on the sources and parsers Cloud Search declares: its build.json::search is baked by reference and its plain-JVM search-core is linked by reference, nothing is copied). The assistant behind the top bar's AI icon is libs:ai's chat over the fleet agent gateway (mesh only); no token is held or read by this app for it (decisions-use guard D5), and the fleet bearer for the public fallback route is read from Cloud Account on use and never kept. Dark is the default theme (#336); English is the base language (#299).

android._doc_application_id: The fleet name with its separator dropped, as cloudcalc / cloudsearch.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud SuperIntel.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph; settings.gradle iterates it. No `logic` lib is compiled in (lib-classes L4): the Store installs and updates this app, as it does Cloud Calc.

The backend is the fleet agent gateway (my-ai-api, mesh only; its address is baked as BuildConfig.AI_GATEWAY_URL by libs/ai/ai-gateway.gradle); no token is held or read here (decisions-use guard D5).

libs:ui-nav-bars._doc: #1154 shared navigation and theme design, shared BY REFERENCE.

libs:theme-background._doc: #1154 shared navigation and theme design, shared BY REFERENCE.

search-core._doc: #1207 shared BY REFERENCE: Cloud Search's plain-JVM core (its build.json::search reader, the source parsers and the cache-backed query engine, the CGC and MCP protocol, the fleet endpoint routing). The Web pages and the Repo pages use it; nothing is copied. Its own suite and PIT run in cloud-search's CI (this app's unit task is scoped to :app).

tests._doc: Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which the ship workflow runs before it builds.

unit._doc: SCOPED to :app on purpose (the browser's shape): an unscoped `gradle test` also runs libs:ai's and search-core's suites, and PIT on search-core with another app's build.json. debug, not release, so the task never configures the release signing config. The suite: the declaration kg.json against build.json::ui and Cloud Search's build.json::search, the fleet calls on a fake network (honest empty states), the installed-apps index, the web pages.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud KG Store: five sections on the bottom nav in this order (#1640), API, Scrapped, Home, Me and Cloud, plus Ask (the assistant behind the AI icon at the top right, not on the bottom nav) and Settings behind the first row. Cloud is the section in `horizontal_two_rows` mode (libs:ui-nav-bars NavSectionLayout; the user may switch it to one row or the side menu in Configs): two groups on the first row, Application and Repo, each with its five pages on the second. Application: Binary (the fleet's binaries), Web/Debug (the apps' debug endpoints), MCP (search tools of the MCP services the apps declare), API Data and API Debug (GET and POST consoles on the fleet API services). Repo: Code (code search), CGC (the two code graph indexes), MCP (the CGC MCP services' search tools), API Semantic and API GraphRAG (the two CGC tools). API is the former Web section renamed (id api, same six pages): News, Media, Shopping, Real Estate, Jobs and Business on Cloud Search's declared sources. Scrapped lists the Headless Browsers stack read from ac_cloud-browser/build.json::ui.domains.headless (the one declaration Cloud Browser's Domains > Headless Browsers draws, #1637), never re-listed here. Home is the overview of the bottom nav. Me clones and serves the repository declared in `me` at runtime (libs:git-ui GitConnect + libs:local-serve). Phone (the installed Android apps index) is no longer on the bottom nav (#1640) and stays declared, with its page and code, so nothing is lost. The data page ids ARE the keys of assets/kg/kg.json::pages (test-kg-store-app.sh and KgConfigTest hold them in step, both ways). Every icon is a libs:ui-icons name. The Profile icon at the top right of the first row opens extapp:cloud-account; the sessions drawer is the hamburger's.

scrapped._doc: #1640 the Scrapped page lists the Headless Browsers stack by reference: the app's build script bakes this declaration key of this file, which is the ONE shared declaration (#1637, Cloud Browser Domains > Headless Browsers; backends #1498 #1540 #1541, command API in libs/headless-api/headless-api.json). Nothing about the stack is typed in this app.

me._doc: #1640 the repository the Me tab clones at RUNTIME (shallow, through libs:git-ui GitConnect, the fleet's one GitHub connect; a private repo asks once for a GitHub token kept encrypted by libs:git-sync) and serves from its clone through libs:local-serve (the Git Sites way, #1615): the html file is rendered in a loopback WebView. No repo content is in the APK; no credential is declared here.
me._doc_repo: #1609 the library repo was renamed HardTech-Chronos -> Projects-Library-KG on 2026-11-12 (public; index.html + topics.md at root). GitHub redirects the old name, so clones made under the old slug keep working.

configs_pages._doc: Configs > General and Configs > About (libs:ui-nav-bars fleetconfigs, rule 1_cicd/src/data/configs-pages.json, #1352 v2). general.sections: the anchors of the one General page, in order (perms, battery, storage, notifications, ui, language are required; app opens this app's own Configs; update is added after perms by default). about: the hand-written part of the extensive About: tagline, description, features, screens, guide, privacy, backends (ids of ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints, resolved to mesh URLs at build time), related fleet apps, credits for a fork. Permissions, data stores, crash/analytics libs, name, icon, version, build sha and date, repo, licence, origin, crash sink, debug API and changelog are derived, never typed here.

about.tagline: The cloud, the phone and the web as one graph
about.description: Cloud KG Store is the fleet's knowledge-graph store and browser. It puts the cloud's code, data and APIs, the phone's installed apps and the web's news, media, shopping, real estate and jobs into one searchable graph, with semantic and GraphRAG search over the repositories and an Ask page that answers from the graph. It exists so a question about anything the owner runs or follows has one place to start.
features: Cloud: binaries, MCP tools, data and debug APIs
Repo: code, CGC, semantic and GraphRAG search
Web: news, media, shopping, real estate, jobs
Scrapped: the Headless Browsers stack with its API and MCP links
Me: a git repository cloned and served on the phone
Ask: answers grounded in the graph

screens.name: Cloud
screens.what: Binaries, MCP tools, data and debug APIs.

screens.name: Web
screens.what: News, media, shopping, real estate, jobs.

guide: Join the private mesh so the graph APIs answer.
Browse Cloud or Web by group.
Ask a question on Ask; follow the cited nodes.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. It talks only to the fleet services listed below, over the private mesh first.

related.why: Search over the same knowledge graph.
Signs in to the fleet and holds the tokens and secrets this app reads.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
